k-pipe-pp-r-sdr-6.seo_p1: The K Pipe PPR SDR 6 is a high-performance pipe from our comprehensive pipe system category. It is designed to handle demanding fluid transport safely and efficiently.
k-pipe-pp-r-sdr-6.seo_p2: This pipe is made of durable PPR material and is designed with the SDR 6 rating (Series S 2.5) for a high operating pressure of up to 2.0 MPa at 20°C. The standard length of 4 meters enables quick installation.
k-pipe-pp-r-sdr-6.seo_p3: Thanks to its excellent chemical and thermal resistance, the SDR 6 pipe is ideal for industrial applications and drinking water supply. The smooth inner surface minimizes pressure loss and prevents deposits.

faq.q: What operating temperatures is SDR 6 suitable for?
faq.a: It is designed for continuous operating temperatures up to 70°C and offers a pressure resistance of 20 bar at 20°C.

faq.q: What are the advantages of the high wall thickness?
faq.a: The SDR 6 series (S 2.5) offers maximum pressure resistance and mechanical stability in heavily loaded systems.

faq.q: Can I use this pipe for cold water?
faq.a: Yes, it is excellent for cold water systems because the smooth surface effectively prevents incrustations and bacterial growth.

k-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-74.seo_p1: The K Pipe PPRCT SDR 7.4 represents the next generation of plastic pipe systems. It combines improved material properties with optimized wall thickness for maximum flow rates.
k-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-74.seo_p2: Made from highly crystalline PPRCT, this pipe offers an impressive nominal pressure of 2.0 MPa at 20°C at SDR 7.4 (S 3.2). The reduced wall thickness saves weight without compromising stability.
k-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-74.seo_p3: Typical areas of application include complex heating, air conditioning, and sanitary systems. Thanks to the PPRCT material, installers benefit from higher long-term strength even at higher temperatures.

faq.q: What does PPRCT mean compared to PPR?
faq.a: PPRCT stands for an improved crystalline structure that allows for higher pressures at higher temperatures, enabling thinner wall thicknesses.

faq.q: Is the flow rate higher with SDR 7.4?
faq.a: Yes, due to the reduced wall thickness of the PPRCT, an up to 17% higher flow capacity is achieved with the same outer diameter.

faq.q: Is SDR 7.4 suitable for heating systems?
faq.a: Absolutely, the material is extremely thermally resistant and therefore ideal for supply lines in modern heating systems.

k-pipe-pp-r-sdr-11.seo_p1: The K-Pipe PP-R SDR 11 is the standard solution for a variety of plumbing and heating applications. It is characterized by its reliability and ease of handling.
k-pipe-pp-r-sdr-11.seo_p2: With an SDR 11 classification (Series S 5), this PP-R pipe is certified for an operating pressure of 1.2 MPa at 20°C. The 4-meter lengths can be welded flexibly and precisely.
k-pipe-pp-r-sdr-11.seo_p3: It is frequently used in cold water distribution and as a versatile pipe in building technology. The homogeneous welded connection guarantees lifetime tightness without mechanical weak points.

faq.q: Is the pipe suitable for cold and hot water?
faq.a: The SDR 11 pipe is primarily designed for cold water (20°C at 12 bar) and the low-pressure hot water range (60°C at 6 bar).

faq.q: How is the PP-R SDR 11 pipe installed?
faq.a: Installation is carried out using the socket fusion welding process, which creates absolutely homogeneous, leak-free connections.

faq.q: Are there weight differences compared to other SDR classes?
faq.a: Yes, due to the thinner wall, the pipe is significantly lighter and more flexible to handle on the construction site.

k-pipe-purple-pp-r-sdr-11.seo_p1: The purple-colored K-Pipe Purple PP-R SDR 11 is used for the clear identification of specific pipe systems. It prevents confusion during the installation of separate water circuits.
k-pipe-purple-pp-r-sdr-11.seo_p2: The purple signal color generally identifies process water, rainwater, or irrigation systems. Technically, it corresponds to standard PP-R with SDR 11 (1.2 MPa at 20°C) and offers the same high quality.
k-pipe-purple-pp-r-sdr-11.seo_p3: The use of this special pipe increases system safety and visually ensures the standard-compliant separation of drinking and process water. Perfect for sustainable water management systems.

faq.q: What does the purple color stand for?
faq.a: It is used to visually distinguish pipe systems for process water, grey water, or rainwater harvesting in accordance with international guidelines.

faq.q: Can the pipe be welded with normal PP-R fittings?
faq.a: Yes, the purple pipe is compatible with all K Aqua standard fittings and is welded using the same parameters.

faq.q: Does the color affect the quality of the material?
faq.a: No, the physical and chemical properties are identical to the regular PP-R SDR 11 pipe.

k-fiber-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-74.seo_p1: The K-Fiber Pipe PPRCT SDR 7.4 is a state-of-the-art, fiber-reinforced composite pipe. The integrated fiber layer significantly reduces linear expansion.
k-fiber-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-74.seo_p2: The innovative PPRCT base is supplemented by a fiber middle layer. With SDR 7.4 (S 3.2), the pipe withstands pressures of up to 2.0 MPa at 20°C, with up to 50% less thermal expansion at the same time.
k-fiber-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-74.seo_p3: This makes the pipe the perfect choice for risers and long runs in building technology, where fewer fastening points are required, which saves installation time and material costs.

faq.q: How much does the fiber reduce thermal linear expansion?
faq.a: The integrated glass fiber layer reduces linear expansion by up to 75% compared to solid PP-R pipes.

faq.q: Does the fiber pipe need to be peeled before welding?
faq.a: No, unlike Stabi pipes with an aluminum layer, our fiber pipe can be welded directly and without pre-treatment.

faq.q: Is the pipe suitable for central risers?
faq.a: Yes, due to its extremely high inherent stiffness and pressure resistance, it is the optimal choice for large risers.

k-fiberclima-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-11.seo_p1: Specialized for cooling and heating water applications, the K-Fiberclima Pipe PPRCT SDR 11 offers optimal performance for climate control systems. It is designed for thermal efficiency and stability.
k-fiberclima-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-11.seo_p2: The fiber-reinforced PPRCT material (SDR 11, S 5) ensures safe operation at 1.6 MPa (20°C) and 0.8 MPa (70°C). The thinner walls allow for an extremely high flow rate.
k-fiberclima-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-11.seo_p3: This pipe particularly shows its strengths in large HVAC systems (heating, ventilation, air conditioning). It prevents corrosion in the cooling circuit and ensures maintenance-free, energy-efficient operation.

faq.q: What makes the pipe ideal for chilled water in climate control systems?
faq.a: The low thermal conductivity of PPRCT prevents condensation significantly better than metallic pipes.

faq.q: How does it behave with the circulation of antifreeze agents?
faq.a: It is highly resistant to common glycols and antifreeze agents, preventing leaks caused by material fatigue.

faq.q: Can the pipes be used for large volume flows?
faq.a: Thanks to the thinner wall (SDR 11) with maximum stability, it allows for extremely large volume flows in industrial networks.

k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-74.seo_p1: The classic K-Fiber Pipe PP-R SDR 7.4 is the proven solution when fiber reinforcement and extreme pressure resistance are required. It effectively minimizes thermal expansion.
k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-74.seo_p2: By combining PP-R and fiber technology, this pipe (SDR 7.4, S 3.2) achieves a peak operating pressure of 2.5 MPa at 20°C. It offers maximum stability for demanding networks.
k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-74.seo_p3: Whether in industrial plant construction or complex domestic hot water circulation systems, this pipe ensures rigid, deformation-free installation and highest operational reliability over decades.

faq.q: Is SDR 7.4 approved for high temperatures?
faq.a: Yes, it tolerates temperatures up to 70°C at a nominal pressure of 1.0 MPa (10 bar) and short-term peaks of 95°C.

faq.q: How many fastening clamps are required for long distances?
faq.a: Thanks to the fiber reinforcement, the fastening distances can be drastically increased compared to standard pipes.

faq.q: Are there corrosion risks with changing water qualities?
faq.a: No, the PP-R material is 100% corrosion-free and independent of the pH value of the transported medium.

k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-9.seo_p1: The K-Fiber Pipe PP-R SDR 9 bridges the gap between standard and high-pressure fiber pipes. It offers an excellent balance of flow capacity and pressure resistance.
k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-9.seo_p2: With the S 4 (SDR 9) series, the PP-R fiber pipe is approved for pressures up to 2.0 MPa at 20°C. The wall thicknesses are optimized for medium to high loads.
k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-9.seo_p3: This pipe is often used in commercial and industrial projects where conventional pipes reach their limits, but the extreme reserves of SDR 7.4 are not yet needed.

faq.q: Why choose SDR 9 instead of SDR 7.4?
faq.a: SDR 9 offers an excellent compromise of higher flow capacity (thinner wall) while still providing extreme pressure resistance.

faq.q: Can it be welded with standard PP-R fittings?
faq.a: Absolutely, the SDR 9 fiber pipe is fully compatible with our K Aqua SDR 6 and SDR 7.4 PP-R fittings.

faq.q: Is it approved for drinking water supply?
faq.a: Yes, it meets all hygienic standards for hot and cold drinking water worldwide.

k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-11.seo_p1: The K-Fiber Pipe PP-R SDR 11 is designed for weight-optimized yet dimensionally stable installations. It combines the advantages of fiber technology with a lightweight profile.
k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-11.seo_p2: The PP-R material with fiber layer in the SDR 11 classification allows pressures up to 1.6 MPa at 20°C. It offers an optimal inner cross-section for large water volumes.
k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-11.seo_p3: It is ideally suited for climate chilled water and large distribution lines. Installation is very fast thanks to the low weight and reduced fastening distances.

faq.q: Are the welding times shorter for SDR 11 pipes?
faq.a: Yes, due to the reduced wall thickness, the heating times on the heating element are shortened, which speeds up the work process.

faq.q: What are the application limits for this SDR 11 pipe?
faq.a: It is designed for maximum pressures of 16 bar at 20°C and 8 bar at 60°C.

faq.q: Do cooling systems benefit from this pipe?
faq.a: Yes, the excellent insulation value significantly minimizes energy loss in cooling networks.

k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-17.seo_p1: The large-dimensioned K-Fiber Pipe PP-R SDR 17 was specially developed for large-scale industrial plants and main supply lines. It offers massive flow cross-sections.
k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-17.seo_p2: With diameters of up to 200 mm and the S 8 (SDR 17) series, this pipe can handle 1.0 MPa at 20°C. The fiber reinforcement ensures high dimensional stability even with these large dimensions.
k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-17.seo_p3: Ideal for district cooling networks, municipal water supply, or as a main riser in high-rise buildings. It is the corrosion-free alternative to heavy metallic large pipes.

faq.q: Is SDR 17 suitable for high network pressure levels?
faq.a: SDR 17 (PN 10) is specially designed for low-pressure networks with enormous volume flows, e.g., district cooling networks.

faq.q: How are such large dimensions connected?
faq.a: Large pipes (from 90 mm to 200 mm) are preferably connected by heating element butt welding or with electrofusion sockets.

faq.q: What is the main advantage over steel pipes?
faq.a: The PP-R pipe does not rust, weighs a fraction of steel pipes, and permanently maintains a perfect flow cross-section.

k-fiber-uv-pipe-pp-r-sdr-74.seo_p1: The K-Fiber UV Pipe PP-R SDR 7.4 solves the problem of UV degradation in unprotected outdoor installations. It features a special, weather-resistant outer layer.
k-fiber-uv-pipe-pp-r-sdr-74.seo_p2: In addition to the thermally stabilizing fiber middle layer and the PP-R base (SDR 7.4, 2.0 MPa), the UV jacket permanently protects the pipe against direct sunlight and weather influences.
k-fiber-uv-pipe-pp-r-sdr-74.seo_p3: This makes it perfect for roof installations, outdoor plants, or bridge lines. Additional insulation or coatings for UV protection can be completely omitted.

faq.q: How is UV protection achieved with this pipe?
faq.a: A special, co-extruded black outer layer absorbs and blocks harmful UV radiation before it attacks the PP-R material.

faq.q: Does the UV layer need to be removed before welding?
faq.a: No, since it is a homogeneous plastic layer, it is simply fused with the fitting during socket welding.

faq.q: Is the outdoor service life limited?
faq.a: The UV protection layer prevents polymer degradation, ensuring the full service life of 50 years even in direct sunlight.

k-fiber-uv-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-74.seo_p1: The premium K-Fiber UV Pipe PPRCT SDR 7.4 combines all top features: high-performance material, fiber reinforcement, and integrated UV protection in a single product.
k-fiber-uv-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-74.seo_p2: Based on PPRCT for highest temperature resistance (up to 70°C at 1.0 MPa) and equipped with a UV-resistant shell, this SDR 7.4 pipe is the ultimate all-rounder for extreme conditions.
k-fiber-uv-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-74.seo_p3: Whether solar connection lines, cooling towers on industrial buildings, or demanding outdoor installations in hot climates, this pipe guarantees maximum service life without material fatigue.

faq.q: Does this pipe combine UV protection with higher flow capacity?
faq.a: Yes, thanks to the highly crystalline PPRCT material, a thinner wall thickness can be used while the UV layer provides extreme outdoor protection.

faq.q: Are UV-resistant K Aqua fittings available?
faq.a: Fittings are usually protected by insulation, paint, or UV protection tapes, while the long pipe runs are factory-protected.

faq.q: Is this pipe suitable for cooling towers?
faq.a: It is the optimal choice, as it permanently withstands both blazing sun and chemical additives in the cooling water.

cap.seo_p1: The Cap is an indispensable fitting within our fittings category, designed for the permanent and secure closure of pipe ends.
cap.seo_p2: Manufactured from high-quality PP-R material, the cap corresponds to the common SDR classes of the pipes and offers maximum pressure resistance and dimensional accuracy for a homogeneous weld.
cap.seo_p3: It is optimally suited for the final or temporary decommissioning of pipe sections in drinking water and heating networks, guaranteeing an absolutely leak-free and maintenance-free seal.

faq.q: Can the cap be used for a pressure test?
faq.a: Yes, after proper welding and cooling, the cap easily withstands the full test pressure of the system (up to 30 bar).

faq.q: How do I seal temporary lines?
faq.a: For temporary shut-offs, we recommend threaded plugs; the cap is homogeneously welded and is thus intended for permanent closure.

faq.q: Is the cap leak-proof at all temperatures?
faq.a: Due to thermal fusion, there are no different expansion coefficients, which means it remains absolutely leak-free from 0°C to 95°C.

socket.seo_p1: The Socket is the fundamental connecting element of our fittings, developed for the simple and reliable extension of straight pipe sections.
socket.seo_p2: Made of robust PP-R, this fitting establishes a materially bonded and extremely pressure-resistant connection through socket welding, which is perfectly matched to our SDR pipe series.
socket.seo_p3: Whether in the private sanitary sector or in industrial plant construction, the socket ensures seamless flow without cross-sectional narrowing and prevents long-term pressure losses.

faq.q: How deep must the pipe be inserted into the socket?
faq.a: The insertion depth is exactly defined in our technical guidelines and should be marked on the pipe to avoid cross-sectional narrowing.

faq.q: Can sockets also be used for fiber pipes?
faq.a: Yes, our standard sockets are fully compatible with all K Aqua PP-R, PPRCT, and fiber pipes.

faq.q: Is there a risk of micro-leaks at the seam?
faq.a: No, because polyfusion creates a materially bonded, molecular connection that is as strong as the pipe itself.

elbow-45.seo_p1: The Elbow 45° allows gentle direction changes in the pipeline course and is one of our most frequently used fittings.
elbow-45.seo_p2: Thanks to precise injection molding from durable PP-R, the elbow guarantees perfect compatibility with all K Aqua piping systems and withstands the highest system pressures.
elbow-45.seo_p3: Particularly with complex pipe routings in narrow shafts or when bypassing obstacles, this 45-degree elbow effectively reduces flow resistance.

faq.q: When should I use a 45-degree instead of a 90-degree elbow?
faq.a: A 45-degree elbow significantly reduces pressure loss and flow resistance (Zeta value) in the system and prevents noise generation.

faq.q: Are K Aqua elbows flow-optimized?
faq.a: Yes, the inner radii of our 45-degree elbows are extremely smooth and hydraulically optimized to prevent cavitation.

faq.q: Can two 45-degree elbows be combined to form a 90-degree bend?
faq.a: Yes, this practice is often used with large dimensions to create wide bends and reduce pump resistance.

elbow-45-femalemale.seo_p1: The Elbow 45° Female/Male offers maximum flexibility in tight spaces and direct connection combinations.
elbow-45-femalemale.seo_p2: The PP-R fitting features a socket end and a spigot end, which allows direct welding to other fittings without an additional pipe piece.
elbow-45-femalemale.seo_p3: In compact manifold installations or when building narrow pre-wall systems, this component saves valuable assembly time and reduces the number of welds.

faq.q: Does a 90-degree elbow increase wear due to flow pressure?
faq.a: Thanks to the wall thickness reserves and the extremely smooth inner surfaces of the PP-R material, wear from abrasion is practically excluded.

faq.q: Are there direction markings on the K Aqua elbows?
faq.a: Yes, our fittings often have production markings that help with exact axial alignment on the construction site.

faq.q: Can the 90-degree elbow be used for riser pipes?
faq.a: Yes, it is ideal for branching lines off from shafts to the respective floor.

elbow-90.seo_p1: The Elbow 90° is the standard direction changer in our fittings range, designed for precise, right-angled branches.
elbow-90.seo_p2: This dimensionally stable PP-R component is constructed to easily absorb the mechanical and thermal loads of the system and is compatible with all SDR levels.
elbow-90.seo_p3: Perfect for corner installations and wall penetrations throughout building services engineering, it guarantees a tight and secure 90-degree bend without edges that disturb the flow.

faq.q: What does M/F (Male/Female) mean for this elbow?
faq.a: One side is welded as a socket, the other side can be directly welded into another fitting.

faq.q: What is the advantage of the M/F construction?
faq.a: It saves space and avoids an additional pipe piece between two fittings, which is crucial in tight spaces.

faq.q: Does this change the welding process?
faq.a: The process remains the same, only the male and female dies on the welding mirror are used simultaneously for the pipe and fitting.

elbow-90-femalemale.seo_p1: The Elbow 90° Female/Male is the solution for ultra-compact corner connections directly to other components.
elbow-90-femalemale.seo_p2: This intelligent PP-R fitting combines a regular socket end with an insertion end to seamlessly implement fitting-to-fitting welds.
elbow-90-femalemale.seo_p3: Especially when installing valves or heating circuit manifolds, this design significantly reduces space requirements and minimizes material and labor costs.

faq.q: Is the 45-degree M/F elbow suitable for parallel offsets?
faq.a: Yes, combined with a standard 45-degree elbow, extremely compact floor offsets can be realized.

faq.q: Is the pressure resistance of the female/male connection just as high?
faq.a: The homogeneous polyfusion welding also ensures 100 percent pressure resistance (PN 25) at the joint here.

faq.q: For which dimensions is this elbow available?
faq.a: It is typically produced for the common dimensions in floor distribution from 20 mm to 40 mm.

electrofusion-socket.seo_p1: The Electrofusion Socket is the premium solution for connections where conventional socket welding is not possible due to space constraints.
electrofusion-socket.seo_p2: Equipped with integrated heating wires made of a special alloy, this PP-R fitting automatically and computer-controlled fuses with the base pipe.
electrofusion-socket.seo_p3: Ideal for repair work in shafts, subsequent extensions, or extremely inaccessible areas, it offers a 100 percent secure and recordable connection.

faq.q: Does the pipe need to be peeled before electrofusion welding?
faq.a: Yes, removing the oxide layer using a special pipe peeler is absolutely necessary for flawless fusion.

faq.q: Which welding machines can be used?
faq.a: K Aqua or universal electrofusion welding machines that can read the barcode on the socket must be used.

faq.q: When is electrofusion welding better than heating element socket welding?
faq.a: Especially in confined spaces (e.g., in a shaft) where there is no room for the socket welding tool.

flange-adaptor.seo_p1: The Flange Adaptor serves as an essential connecting element to securely and detachably connect plastic pipes to metallic flanges or valves.
flange-adaptor.seo_p2: The PP-R component is shaped to provide a perfect fit for backing flanges and evenly transfers the high contact pressure to the gasket.
flange-adaptor.seo_p3: Indispensable in industrial pipeline construction and large distribution systems, the flange adaptor enables the safe transition to pumps, large valves, and steel systems.

faq.q: Which flange standards does the K Aqua flange adaptor support?
faq.a: It is compatible with standard DIN/EN flanges (e.g., PN10, PN16) and requires the appropriate K Aqua backing flange.

faq.q: Do I need an additional gasket?
faq.a: Yes, a suitable EPDM flat gasket must be inserted between the PP-R flange adaptor and the counter flange.

faq.q: How is the flange adaptor connected to the pipe?
faq.a: It is welded directly onto the pipe or into a socket like a conventional fitting using heating element socket welding.

reducing-bush.seo_p1: The Reducing Bush enables a seamless transition between different pipe dimensions within our fittings family.
reducing-bush.seo_p2: Manufactured from high-strength PP-R, this reducer is designed to optimize flow and avoid cavitation at the cross-sectional change.
reducing-bush.seo_p3: It is frequently used to taper main lines into smaller supply branches, reducing material costs and precisely balancing network pressure.

faq.q: Can I skip several dimensions at once?
faq.a: Yes, we offer reducers that achieve multi-stage cross-sectional narrowing in one component, e.g., from 63 mm to 32 mm.

faq.q: Is the reducing bush welded into or onto the pipe?
faq.a: The reducer is usually designed as a male/female (M/F) fitting: the large side fits into a socket, the small side accepts the pipe.

faq.q: Does the reduction affect the operating pressure?
faq.a: No, the wall thicknesses of the K Aqua reducers are dimensioned to match the nominal pressure of the overall system (up to PN 25).

reducing-tee.seo_p1: The Reducing Tee combines a 90-degree branch with a simultaneous cross-sectional reduction in the branch.
reducing-tee.seo_p2: This multifunctional PP-R fitting offers maximum stability and pressure resistance due to its monolithic design, suitable for all standard SDR applications.
reducing-tee.seo_p3: In the floor distribution of drinking and heating water, the reducing tee ensures an efficient setup without additional reducers, which significantly speeds up installation.

faq.q: When do I use a reducing tee instead of a standard tee with a reducer?
faq.a: A reducing tee saves an additional weld seam and reduces installation space, making it more efficient and safer.

faq.q: Is the branch always the reduced side?
faq.a: Mostly yes, since smaller branches are typically led from the main line to the consumers.

faq.q: Can these tees cause flow noise?
faq.a: No, the inner radii are hydraulically optimized to minimize turbulence and cavitation noise during cross-sectional changes.

reducing-tee-large-sizes.seo_p1: The Reducing Tee Large Sizes is specially designed for industrial main lines with large cross-sections.
reducing-tee-large-sizes.seo_p2: This massive PP-R component withstands extreme volume flows and system pressures and enables a safe, reduced branch from large supply lines.
reducing-tee-large-sizes.seo_p3: Often used in district cooling networks and main risers, this fitting guarantees absolute stability and permanent leak-tightness under the highest loads.

faq.q: What special tools are needed for installation?
faq.a: An exact hole milling requires a special K Aqua tapping drill, as well as a saddle welding tool for heating.

faq.q: Can a saddle be mounted on a pressurized pipe?
faq.a: No, the piping system must be completely emptied and depressurized before tapping and welding takes place.

faq.q: Is the saddle connection as strong as a tee?
faq.a: Yes, through the deep polyfusion welding on the pipe wall, the saddle branch achieves the same pressure rating as the base pipe.

tee.seo_p1: The Tee is the classic branch fitting for symmetrical flow division in PP-R networks.
tee.seo_p2: Made of robust polypropylene (PP-R), it offers three equally dimensioned socket ends that fully support the nominal pressure of the piping system.
tee.seo_p3: It is the heart of every ring and series line in sanitary installations and ensures reliable, low-pressure-loss distribution of the medium.

faq.q: Does the tee reduce the pipe cross-section?
faq.a: No, the interior design of our tees is designed for full bore so as not to throttle the volume flow.

faq.q: Is a tee more susceptible to deposits?
faq.a: Thanks to the extremely smooth PP-R material (roughness value 0.007 mm), limescale and biofilms have no chance of settling even in the branches.

faq.q: Are different welding times required for large tees?
faq.a: Yes, the heating, changeover, and cooling times depend on the dimension and must be strictly observed according to DVS guidelines.

cross.seo_p1: The Cross allows a main flow to be distributed in three different directions within a compact installation level.
cross.seo_p2: This four-way PP-R fitting is flow-optimized to minimize turbulence and seamlessly integrates into our high-pressure SDR series.
cross.seo_p3: Perfect for complex distribution cabinets and central crossing points in building services, it replaces multiple tees and thus saves valuable installation space and time.

faq.q: Does the cross cause high pressure losses?
faq.a: Since four flows can meet, the Zeta value is higher than with straight pipes, but the generous interior design keeps the loss minimal.

faq.q: In which situations is a cross mandatory?
faq.a: Especially in pre-wall installations or underfloor heating manifolds, where construction must be extremely flat and symmetrical.

faq.q: Are the branches always the same size?
faq.a: In our standard cross, all four connections have the same dimensions (e.g., 4x 20mm).

cross-over.seo_p1: The Cross-over is a clever solution for crossing cold and hot water lines in confined spaces.
cross-over.seo_p2: The curved PP-R fitting features integrated socket ends and an elegant bridge shape that allows pipe routing on one level without height offset.
cross-over.seo_p3: It prevents collisions in wall installations and underfloor heating and guarantees smooth flow with a visually perfect, flat pipe layout.

faq.q: How big is the curve of the gooseneck?
faq.a: The bend is precisely dimensioned so that a crossing K Aqua pipe of the same or smaller dimension is bridged without contact.

faq.q: Are special sockets needed for installation?
faq.a: The gooseneck (cross-over) typically has unwelded pipe ends and is integrated into the system on both sides with standard sockets.

faq.q: Can I shape a straight PP-R pipe into a cross-over myself using heat?
faq.a: No! Manual bending with hot air guns destroys the molecular structure of the pipe and immediately voids the warranty.

cross-over-pipe.seo_p1: The Cross-over Pipe is the extended version of the cross-over, ideal for pipe bridges without direct socket connection at the ends.
cross-over-pipe.seo_p2: Manufactured from high-quality PP-R, this bridge component offers pure insertion ends that allow maximum flexibility when positioning the welding sockets.
cross-over-pipe.seo_p3: Installers use this component for difficult crossings in large distribution systems to flexibly adapt the routing to the conditions on site.

faq.q: What is the difference between the crossing tee and the cross?
faq.a: The crossing tee allows crossing a line without contact and integrates a branch at the same time.

faq.q: How is this component welded?
faq.a: It is integrated into the pipeline network analogous to standard fittings by means of heating element socket welding.

faq.q: Is the flow hindered by the construction?
faq.a: Despite the compact geometry, the interior is flow-optimized so that no significant cross-sectional narrowing occurs.

adaptor-socket-female-thread.seo_p1: The Adaptor Socket Female Thread forms an essential interface between the welded PP-R piping system and metallic threaded components.
adaptor-socket-female-thread.seo_p2: It combines a robust PP-R socket body with a high-quality metal insert (female thread). This ensures excellent pressure resistance at standard SDR levels.
adaptor-socket-female-thread.seo_p3: This fitting is indispensable when connecting valves, pressure gauges, and special fittings in building installations to guarantee permanently drip-free transitions.

faq.q: What is the mounting plate for?
faq.a: The integrated plate with holes enables the rigid, mechanical fixation of the elbow directly to the wall or a mounting element.

faq.q: Is the metal thread susceptible to corrosion?
faq.a: No, the metallic inserts are made of high-quality, dezincification-resistant brass and are therefore highly corrosion-resistant.

faq.q: Can I seal the thread with hemp?
faq.a: We recommend using Teflon tape (PTFE tape). If using hemp, it should only be used very sparingly and with non-swelling paste to avoid bursting the brass insert.

adaptor-socket-male-thread.seo_p1: The Adaptor Socket Male Thread allows the firm and secure connection of the PP-R network to subsequent metallic pipelines.
adaptor-socket-male-thread.seo_p2: A pull-out-proof anchoring of the brass male thread in the high-strength polypropylene body prevents twisting and guarantees extreme longevity at high temperature and pressure fluctuations.
adaptor-socket-male-thread.seo_p3: Frequently used when connecting boilers, heat pumps, or filters, this socket ensures a permanent and standard-compliant threaded connection.

faq.q: Is the female thread entirely made of brass?
faq.a: Yes, the female thread is a solid, high-quality brass insert securely and twist-proof molded into the PP-R material.

faq.q: Can the connection be loosened if necessary?
faq.a: Yes, the metallic thread allows the safe disassembly of connected equipment such as pumps or filters at any time.

faq.q: What is the maximum tightening torque?
faq.a: The thread should be tightened with standard tools and care to avoid stress cracks in the adjacent plastic.

elbow-90-male-thread.seo_p1: The Elbow 90° Male Thread combines a right-angled change of direction with a direct threaded connection to metal components.
elbow-90-male-thread.seo_p2: This dimensionally stable PP-R component is equipped with a solid male thread insert that absorbs thermal expansion and meets the high demands of SDR pressure classes.
elbow-90-male-thread.seo_p3: Ideal for tight installation situations on machines or manifolds where a direct 90-degree connection must be made without further fitting combinations.

faq.q: Does this fitting combine two work steps?
faq.a: Yes, it combines a change of direction by 90 degrees with a threaded transition, which saves space, material, and a weld seam.

faq.q: Is the male thread roughened?
faq.a: Yes, K Aqua male threads are often slightly roughened at the factory so that the sealing tape (Teflon) does not slip off when screwed in.

faq.q: What material is the male thread made of?
faq.a: It consists of dezincification-resistant special brass, which is approved for the highest hygiene requirements in the drinking water sector.

elbow-bracket-90-female-thread.seo_p1: The Elbow Bracket 90° Female Thread is the standard component for a stable and secure wall mounting of outlet valves.
elbow-bracket-90-female-thread.seo_p2: Thanks to the integrated mounting lugs on the PP-R body and the robust metal female thread, it safely transfers all leverage forces into the masonry.
elbow-bracket-90-female-thread.seo_p3: It is used across the board in the installation of showers, bathtubs, or sinks to mount faucets exactly and twist-proof.

faq.q: Can the wall bracket also be used in drywall?
faq.a: Yes, in combination with our special K Aqua mounting plates, it can be perfectly fixed in plasterboard or wooden stud walls.

faq.q: Is there sound insulation for this component?
faq.a: For optimal sound insulation, we offer optional rubber sound insulation caps that decouple the wall bracket from the building structure.

faq.q: What material is the female thread made of?
faq.a: We exclusively use lead-free or dezincification-resistant (DZR) special brass, compliant with the strictest drinking water regulations.

elbowwall-bracket-90-female-thread.seo_p1: The Extended Elbow Wall Bracket 90° Female Thread offers additional flexibility for deeper concealed installations due to its greater distance.
elbowwall-bracket-90-female-thread.seo_p2: With an extended PP-R neck and a high-strength brass female thread, this component is designed for installations that have to bridge thick plaster or tile thicknesses.
elbowwall-bracket-90-female-thread.seo_p3: Sanitary installers use this element when fitting connections are deeply recessed in drywall to maintain full pressure stability.

faq.q: When is a wall bracket with a male thread used instead of a female thread?
faq.a: It is typically required when flexible reinforced hoses (e.g., from washbasin fittings) are to be connected directly with a union nut.

faq.q: Is the mounting plate stable enough under strong tension?
faq.a: Yes, thanks to the three integrated screw eyelets, the leverage is dissipated over a large area, making the wall mounting extremely stable.

faq.q: Can extensions be screwed on?
faq.a: If the wall bracket sits too deep in the wall, standard brass tap extensions can easily be screwed on.

metal-union-male-thread-yellow-brass.seo_p1: The Metal Union Male Thread Yellow Brass enables detachable connections between PP-R and metal at the highest quality level.
metal-union-male-thread-yellow-brass.seo_p2: The uncoated quality brass is firmly connected to the weldable PP-R socket. An integrated sealing ring guarantees safety in all common SDR pressure classes.
metal-union-male-thread-yellow-brass.seo_p3: Used primarily in drinking water installations for connecting water meters or pumps that need to be dismantled quickly for maintenance purposes.

faq.q: Is this tee suitable for connecting drain valves?
faq.a: Yes, the female thread in the branch is the standard solution for directly screwing in drain or KFE valves at the lowest point.

faq.q: Is the brass insert firmly anchored?
faq.a: Through a special knurling on the brass insert, it is permanently enclosed by the PP-R, which prevents twisting when threading.

faq.q: Does the thread reduce the flow in the main line?
faq.a: No, the main line of the tee (the passage) has a full cross-section and is flow-optimized.

metal-union-female-thread-yellow-brass.seo_p1: The Metal Union Female Thread Yellow Brass is the ideal solution for highly resilient, separable pipe connections.
metal-union-female-thread-yellow-brass.seo_p2: Equipped with a high-quality brass union nut and a PP-R welding end, this union offers an absolutely tension-free and tight connection.
metal-union-female-thread-yellow-brass.seo_p3: It is frequently used to integrate maintenance elements, filters, or valves in the pipeline network that are regularly cleaned or replaced.

faq.q: Where is the tee with male thread typically used?
faq.a: It is ideal for directly branching off equipment with a female thread or union nuts (e.g., strainers or small circulation pumps).

faq.q: Is there a risk of cracking in the plastic with male threads?
faq.a: No, because with male threads the expansion force of the sealant (Teflon) acts on the solid brass body and not on the plastic.

faq.q: Can I use it in hot water systems?
faq.a: Of course. Like all K Aqua transition fittings, it is approved for continuous temperatures up to 70°C and short-term peaks of 95°C.

metal-union-male-thread.seo_p1: The nickel-plated Metal Union Male Thread combines an elegant appearance with outstanding technical detachability between plastic and metal systems.
metal-union-male-thread.seo_p2: The nickel-plated threaded insert effectively protects against external influences and corrosion, while the PP-R body has the usual pressure and temperature resistance for SDR pipes.
metal-union-male-thread.seo_p3: Particularly preferred in visible pre-wall installations or heating construction, it guarantees clean transitions to metallic radiators or manifolds.

faq.q: What is the advantage of a union compared to a transition socket?
faq.a: The union is separable. This means that the connected component can later be easily dismantled without cutting the PP-R pipe.

faq.q: Is the seal included in the union?
faq.a: Yes, K Aqua unions are supplied as standard with a high-quality EPDM flat gasket (for water).

faq.q: May the union nut be tightened with heavy tools?
faq.a: It should be tightened hand-tight plus a quarter turn with a suitable open-end wrench so as not to crush the seal.

metal-union-female-thread.seo_p1: The nickel-plated Metal Union Female Thread is the premium connecting element for visually demanding and detachable system transitions.
metal-union-female-thread.seo_p2: The combination of a nickel-plated brass union nut and robust polypropylene (PP-R) creates a dimensionally stable, permanently sealed connection for high network pressure levels.
metal-union-female-thread.seo_p3: This fitting is the preferred choice when connecting heat exchangers or pump groups in the heating cellar where corrosion protection is important.

faq.q: Where is this male thread union required?
faq.a: Often as a device connection fitting for water meters or heat exchangers that have a female thread on the housing.

faq.q: Does the PP-R remain tension-free when tightened?
faq.a: Yes, the loose union nut absorbs the torsional forces during tightening, so that no torsional stress is transferred into the welded pipe network.

faq.q: Is the brass material certified for drinking water?
faq.a: We exclusively use high-purity DZR brass, which meets all standards of the European Drinking Water Directive (UBA list).

tee-90-male-thread.seo_p1: The Tee 90° Male Thread enables a seamless transition from a continuous PP-R line to a metallic branch.
tee-90-male-thread.seo_p2: The T-body made of PP-R ensures undisturbed longitudinal flow, while the branching metal insert (male thread) defies the highest shear forces and system pressures.
tee-90-male-thread.seo_p3: Ideal for the direct installation of sensors, drain valves, or pressure gauges in the middle of the pipe run without mechanically weakening the main network.

faq.q: What are the advantages of the welding saddle over a tee?
faq.a: It allows subsequent branches without cutting the main line and minimizes the impact on system integrity.

faq.q: How is the saddle mounted?
faq.a: The main pipe is tapped with a special drill, then the pipe and saddle are simultaneously heated and precisely fused.

faq.q: Is it suitable for sprinkler systems?
faq.a: The K Aqua saddle branch is successfully used in some international markets for connecting sprinkler heads in lightweight construction.

tee-90-female-thread.seo_p1: The Tee 90° Female Thread is a versatile component to integrate a valve or a sensor directly into a continuous PP-R line.
tee-90-female-thread.seo_p2: With two welding sockets for the flow and a solid female thread branch, this component meets all stability requirements within the SDR pressure classes.
tee-90-female-thread.seo_p3: Often used for connecting sampling valves in drinking water distributions or as an interface for thermometers in heating systems.

faq.q: Does the saddle with male thread offer the same strength?
faq.a: Absolutely. The brass insert is deeply anchored in the PP-R matrix, ensuring the component remains fully pressure resistant (PN 25).

faq.q: Are there limitations on the branch size?
faq.a: For technical reasons, the diameter of the saddle branch must always be significantly smaller than the diameter of the main line (e.g., 63 mm to 1/2").

faq.q: Can the saddle also be welded to fiber pipes?
faq.a: Yes, it is equally suitable for all K Aqua pipe types (standard, PPRCT, fiber, UV) after local tapping.

union.seo_p1: The all-plastic Union is a connecting element made entirely of polypropylene (PP-R) that creates a detachable connection without metallic components.
union.seo_p2: With a reliable sealing system and robust plastic union nuts, this union fully withstands the standard operating pressure of the PP-R piping system.
union.seo_p3: It is indispensable for completely corrosion-free systems, such as in the chemical industry or with aggressive media where metal contact must be strictly avoided.

faq.q: When do I choose a PP-R flange instead of a metallic backing flange?
faq.a: A PP-R flange is used when the pumped medium is highly corrosive and any contact with metal must be avoided (all-plastic system).

faq.q: Are there pressure restrictions for all-plastic flanges?
faq.a: Since plastic is more flexible than steel, the maximum nominal pressures for plastic flanges are slightly reduced in the larger dimensions.

faq.q: Are special washers required for the screws?
faq.a: Yes, it is strongly recommended to use large-area washers to distribute the clamping force of the screw evenly on the plastic.

union-for-watermeters.seo_p1: The Union for Watermeters was specifically developed for the tension-free and standard-compliant integration of water meters into PP-R pipelines.
union-for-watermeters.seo_p2: The design includes a weldable PP-R end and a sealing option on the solid union nut, designed for the standard network pressures of drinking water systems.
union-for-watermeters.seo_p3: It allows a quick and safe change of the counting units without tool wear and prevents leaks through a precisely fitting flat gasket.

faq.q: What distinguishes a water meter union?
faq.a: It typically has a sealing option and special thread dimensions that are exactly matched to standard water meters.

faq.q: Are the seals designed for hot water?
faq.a: Depending on the version, the included special seals are specified for cold water meters or also for hot water (heat meters).

faq.q: Can the PP-R pipe bear the weight of the water meter?
faq.a: For larger and heavier meters (house connection), we recommend a separate support for the meter so as not to mechanically stress the pipe network.

pp-r-ball-valve-ball-in-pp.seo_p1: The PP-R Ball Valve Ball in PP is a completely corrosion-free shut-off valve for the highest hygiene requirements.
pp-r-ball-valve-ball-in-pp.seo_p2: This all-plastic valve has a durable PP-R body and a precisely manufactured ball made of polypropylene. It reliably withstands the system pressures of the SDR classes.
pp-r-ball-valve-ball-in-pp.seo_p3: It is frequently used in chemical industrial plants or with demineralized water because it systematically eliminates any metal contact with the pumped medium.

faq.q: What is the advantage of a plastic ball in the valve?
faq.a: It prevents corrosion and ion release into the medium, which is absolutely necessary for ultrapure water or aggressive chemicals.

faq.q: Is the valve also suitable for hot water?
faq.a: Yes, the special thermoplastic of the ball and the Teflon seals (PTFE) guarantee full function even at high temperatures.

faq.q: How is the valve maintained?
faq.a: Thanks to their design, K Aqua PP-R ball valves are absolutely maintenance-free and designed for decades of trouble-free operation.

pp-r-ball-valve-ball-in-brass-chromium-p.seo_p1: The PP-R Ball Valve Ball in Brass Chromium Plated combines the weldability of plastic with the mechanical hardness of metal.
pp-r-ball-valve-ball-in-brass-chromium-p.seo_p2: Embedded in a solid PP-R body, the high-gloss chrome-plated brass ball ensures extremely low-friction and wear-free shut-off even at high temperature differences.
pp-r-ball-valve-ball-in-brass-chromium-p.seo_p3: This is the standard valve for the main shut-off in drinking water and heating networks, characterized by absolute reliability and a long, maintenance-free service life.

faq.q: Does the brass ball offer flow advantages?
faq.a: Yes, the chrome-plated brass ball can be manufactured with thinner walls, allowing a full, resistance-free passage.

faq.q: Is the brass ball suitable for drinking water?
faq.a: Of course, we exclusively use high-purity, certified DZR brass, which does not release heavy metals into the drinking water.

faq.q: Can the valve be integrated into existing metal pipe networks?
faq.a: Yes, in combination with transition sockets or flanges, it can easily be used as a shut-off valve in mixed installations.

tee-90-female-thread-for-internal-valve.seo_p1: The Tee 90° Female Thread for Internal Valve forms the basis for an invisible and space-saving valve installation in the wall.
tee-90-female-thread-for-internal-valve.seo_p2: It consists of a PP-R flow body with a specially deep-drawn brass female thread in the branch that allows the accommodation of valve head parts.
tee-90-female-thread-for-internal-valve.seo_p3: Sanitary professionals use this component in pre-wall installations for showers and bathtubs to integrate shut-off valves aesthetically and safely behind tiles.

faq.q: What is the function of the concealed valve?
faq.a: It allows line shut-off of individual wet rooms (e.g., bathroom or kitchen) directly on site without having to go to the basement.

faq.q: How deep can the valve sit in the wall?
faq.a: The installation depth is variable. If the valve sits too deep due to thick tile construction, we offer corresponding spindle extensions.

faq.q: Is the spindle replaceable?
faq.a: Yes, the entire mechanical internal head part (spindle, seal) can be unscrewed and replaced if necessary without opening the wall.

concealed-valve-chrome-light-part.seo_p1: The Concealed Valve Chrome Light Part offers an elegant visible component for wall-integrated shut-offs.
concealed-valve-chrome-light-part.seo_p2: The set includes a handle and a rosette made of chrome-plated ABS plastic, suitable for the standardized brass spindles of our concealed valve bodies.
concealed-valve-chrome-light-part.seo_p3: It serves for the comfortable and visually appealing water shut-off directly in the wet room, ideal for modern and cost-sensitive property constructions.

faq.q: Is the chrome handle included in the delivery?
faq.a: Yes, this set includes the PP-R valve base as well as the complete, high-gloss chrome-plated visible set including rosette.

faq.q: Can the rosette be mounted after tiling?
faq.a: Of course. The base body is welded under plaster, the rosette and handle are only attached after the wall has been completed.

faq.q: What material is the handle made of?
faq.a: The rotary handle consists of a robust zinc die-cast alloy (Zamak) with a durable, easy-care chrome coating.

concealed-valve-chrome-heavy-part.seo_p1: The heavy concealed valve upper part made of chrome-plated brass (Concealed Valve Chrome Heavy Part) is the premium choice for exclusive bathroom fittings.
concealed-valve-chrome-heavy-part.seo_p2: The rosette and operating handle are made of solid, high-gloss chrome-plated brass, which ensures maximum mechanical resilience and an elegant feel.
concealed-valve-chrome-heavy-part.seo_p3: This version withstands intensive use in hotels or public sanitary facilities and retains its flawless shine for decades.

faq.q: What distinguishes the 'Long' model from the standard concealed valve?
faq.a: The extended spindle design effortlessly bridges deep wall structures, such as thick marble slabs or double-layer drywall.

faq.q: Does the handle have a color marking?
faq.a: Yes, interchangeable color markings (red/blue) are included with our sets for easy distinction between hot and cold water lines.

faq.q: How is the valve seat sealed?
faq.a: We use highly heat-resistant EPDM profile seals in the inner upper part, which are extremely resistant to chemical cleaners and thermal disinfection.

straight-seat-valve-upper-part-green-han.seo_p1: The straight seat valve upper part with green handle (Straight Seat Valve Upper Part Green Handle) is the proven mechanism for precise flow regulation.
straight-seat-valve-upper-part-green-han.seo_p2: Equipped with a high-quality brass spindle, a durable EPDM seal, and the distinctive green handwheel, it is designed for high system pressures and temperatures.
straight-seat-valve-upper-part-green-han.seo_p3: Screwed into the corresponding PP-R valve lower parts, it is used for safe branch shut-off in heating cellars and main distributions of building services.

faq.q: Is this component a spare part?
faq.a: Yes, it is the complete internal mechanical working (upper part) of the concealed valve, ideal for maintenance purposes or modular assembly.

faq.q: Does the entire valve need to be replaced if it drips?
faq.a: No, it is sufficient to turn off the water and replace this brass upper part; the PP-R base body remains in the wall.

faq.q: How often does the upper part need to be greased?
faq.a: The spindle thread is provided with a food-safe permanent lubrication ex works; subsequent maintenance is not required.

elongation-pieces.seo_p1: The elongation pieces are indispensable problem solvers when fitting connections are hidden too deep in the masonry.
elongation-pieces.seo_p2: These solid brass components extend the thread of concealed valves outwards with millimeter precision, without reducing the flow cross-section or compromising pressure resistance.
elongation-pieces.seo_p3: They save installations in the event of subsequently increased wall structures or thick tile coverings and ensure the problem-free assembly of the visible operating elements.

faq.q: When do I need a valve extension?
faq.a: If the plaster or tiles turn out thicker than planned and the spindle of the concealed valve no longer protrudes far enough from the wall.

faq.q: Can multiple extensions be combined?
faq.a: Technically this is possible, but for reasons of stability we recommend using a long upper part ('Long') immediately instead.

faq.q: Is the extension thread standardized?
faq.a: Yes, the threads of our extensions fit exactly onto the standard upper parts of the K Aqua concealed valves.

battery-female-thread.seo_p1: The distribution battery with female thread (Battery Female Thread) bundles several outlets in a compact, pre-assembled PP-R component.
battery-female-thread.seo_p2: Made from a continuous polypropylene body with integrated brass female threads, it offers absolute dimensional stability with a perfect pitch for fittings.
battery-female-thread.seo_p3: This battery drastically speeds up the installation of washbasin or shower fittings, as the time-consuming measuring and alignment of individual wall plates is eliminated.

faq.q: What is the pitch of the fitting battery?
faq.a: It is fixed to the international standard pitch of 150 mm, suitable for 99% of all standard surface-mounted mixer taps.

faq.q: Can the battery be bent?
faq.a: No, the integrated plastic bridge ensures rigid, exact distances. For different dimensions we recommend individual wall plates.

faq.q: How is the battery attached?
faq.a: It has several pre-drilled mounting eyelets to securely fix it to brick, concrete or drywall with screws.

adjustable-battery-female-thread.seo_p1: The adjustable distribution battery (Adjustable Battery Female Thread) offers maximum flexibility when installing wall fittings with different pitches.
adjustable-battery-female-thread.seo_p2: Thanks to a sliding PP-R rail system, the positions of the integrated female threads can be precisely adjusted and then firmly locked in place.
adjustable-battery-female-thread.seo_p3: It is the ideal solution for renovation projects or special specialized fittings where the standard pitch of 150 mm cannot be applied.

faq.q: How flexible is the distance adjustment?
faq.a: Thanks to the sliding rail, the wall plates can be infinitely adjusted to the exact pitch required for the mixer tap.

faq.q: Is there a risk of displacement with the adjustable version?
faq.a: Once the correct dimension has been set, the wall plates are firmly locked in place. Slipping during tiling is therefore impossible.

faq.q: Is a spirit level necessary for alignment?
faq.a: Yes, as with all fitting connections, the mounting plate should be carefully leveled with a spirit level before final fixing.

weld-in-saddle.seo_p1: The weld-in saddle is a revolutionary solution for creating subsequent branches without severing the main line.
weld-in-saddle.seo_p2: The saddle-shaped PP-R fitting is welded directly onto the pipe wall after the main pipe has been drilled. This guarantees the same pressure resistance as the original pipe.
weld-in-saddle.seo_p3: In industrial networks and risers, this component saves enormous assembly times, as main lines do not have to be completely dismantled for extensions.

faq.q: What is the difference to the saddle with metal thread?
faq.a: This weld-in saddle has a pure PP-R branch into which a pipe or another fitting (socket) can be welded directly.

faq.q: Does the pipe wall of the main pipe have to have a minimum thickness?
faq.a: No, the saddle can be safely welded onto all K Aqua pressure levels (SDR 6 to SDR 17) if drilled correctly.

faq.q: How long does the drilling and welding process take?
faq.a: An experienced installer needs a maximum of 3-5 minutes for drilling, heating with the special saddle tool, and joining.

weld-in-saddle-female-thread.seo_p1: The weld-in saddle with female thread (Weld-in Saddle Female Thread) combines the advantages of fast saddle installation with a direct metal connection.
weld-in-saddle-female-thread.seo_p2: In addition to the PP-R saddle body, this fitting features a firmly anchored brass female thread that provides an extremely twist-resistant base for valves.
weld-in-saddle-female-thread.seo_p3: Ideal for the subsequent installation of drain valves, air vents or measuring sensors directly into existing main lines without time-consuming pipe network separation.

faq.q: What is the main advantage of this weld-in saddle?
faq.a: It enables the direct installation of a metal female thread on an existing pipeline, which is extremely time and space saving.

faq.q: Can thermometers be screwed in here?
faq.a: Yes, the saddle is the ideal interface for integrating temperature sensors or small pressure gauges permanently and pressure-tight into heating networks.

faq.q: Is the brass thread protected from tearing out?
faq.a: Absolutely. The brass insert is injected deep into the PP-R structure and anchored mechanically inseparably by special knurling.

weld-in-saddle-male-thread.seo_p1: The weld-in saddle with male thread (Weld-in Saddle Male Thread) allows the immediate connection of system components with union nuts to a base pipe.
weld-in-saddle-male-thread.seo_p2: The seamlessly welded PP-R saddle carries a solid brass male thread that withstands highest leverage forces and permanent temperature changes.
weld-in-saddle-male-thread.seo_p3: This component is frequently used in manifold construction to mount shut-off valves or pump outlets extremely space-savingly and aerodynamically.

faq.q: For which connections is the male thread on the saddle suitable?
faq.a: It is optimally suited for the direct connection of fittings with female threads or for connections secured with a union nut.

faq.q: Is this saddle available for all pipe dimensions?
faq.a: The weld-in saddle is available for main pipes from 40 mm to 125 mm, with the male thread typically being 1/2" or 3/4".

faq.q: How is the tightness ensured after drilling?
faq.a: The fusing of the saddle and pipe creates a cohesive, homogeneous connection that is 100% tight at the molecular level.

pipe-clamps.seo_p1: The pipe clamps form the mechanical foundation for standardized and durable fastening of PP-R piping systems.
pipe-clamps.seo_p2: Equipped with sound-decoupling rubber inserts and sturdy steel hinges, these clamps safely absorb the thermal linear expansion of the pipe.
pipe-clamps.seo_p3: They are absolutely essential to fix pipe runs to walls or ceilings and to effectively isolate pipe noise from the building structure.

faq.q: What is the rubber insert in the clamp for?
faq.a: The EPDM insert serves for sound decoupling according to DIN 4109 and prevents the transmission of flow noise to the masonry.

faq.q: Should the clamp be mounted as a fixed point or sliding point?
faq.a: Depending on the tightening torque of the screws, the clamp can be used both as a fixing fixed point and as a sliding sliding point for thermal linear expansion.

faq.q: What thread connection do the pipe clamps have?
faq.a: Our standard pipe clamps have a welded combination nut (M8/M10), which allows flexible fastening to common hanger bolts or threaded rods.

backing-flange-pp-steel-sfbf.seo_p1: The PP/Steel backing flange (Backing Flange PP/Steel SFBF) ensures a highly resilient and dimensionally stable flange connection for large pipe diameters.
backing-flange-pp-steel-sfbf.seo_p2: A steel core, completely coated with robust polypropylene (PP), completely prevents corrosion and prevents bending under high contact pressure.
backing-flange-pp-steel-sfbf.seo_p3: This accessory is crucial for the transition to large pumps or steel tanks in industrial plants, where extreme tensile forces must be safely dissipated.

faq.q: Why is the steel core coated with polypropylene?
faq.a: The plastic coating permanently protects the high-strength steel from corrosion, which is particularly crucial in damp basements or aggressive industrial environments.

faq.q: Does the hole pattern meet standard norms?
faq.a: Yes, the drilling pattern of our backing flanges is exactly aligned with the European DIN EN 1092-1 standard and fits all standard counter flanges.

faq.q: Do the screws have to be tightened with a torque wrench?
faq.a: We strongly recommend cross-tightening with a calibrated torque wrench to ensure uniform compression of the seal.

flat-gasket.seo_p1: The flat gasket is the essential sealing element for all flange connections within our PP-R system.
flat-gasket.seo_p2: Punched from high-quality EPDM or other elastomers, the gasket is specially tailored to the smooth end faces of the flange adapters and withstands high mains pressure.
flat-gasket.seo_p3: It compensates for microscopic unevenness and ensures a 100% leak-free and durable connection for flange transitions in industry or heating technology.

faq.q: What material is the flat gasket made of?
faq.a: By default, our flange gaskets are made of high-pressure-resistant EPDM, which is excellently suited for drinking water and heating water.

faq.q: Can the gasket be reused?
faq.a: No, for safety reasons a new flat gasket must always be used after a flange connection has been loosened.

faq.q: Is the gasket resistant to chemicals?
faq.a: EPDM offers good resistance to many aqueous solutions. For specific industrial chemicals, please check our resistance lists beforehand.

flat-gasket-for-unions-pp-r.seo_p1: The flat gasket for unions (Flat Gasket for Unions PP-R) is precisely dimensioned for our plastic and metal unions.
flat-gasket-for-unions-pp-r.seo_p2: The elastomer material, approved for drinking water, offers a high restoring force and is resistant to permanent thermal loads in hot water networks.
flat-gasket-for-unions-pp-r.seo_p3: Regular replacement of this gasket after maintenance work on valves or pumps guarantees the permanent tightness of the screw connection.

faq.q: How tight can the union be tightened?
faq.a: To avoid destroying the seal, the union nut should be tightened hand-tight and then only slightly (approx. 1/4 turn) with a tool.

faq.q: Are these gaskets also available in other materials?
faq.a: For extreme temperature requirements or special industrial media, we can also offer gaskets made of FKM (Viton) or PTFE upon request.

faq.q: Does this gasket fit on other brands?
faq.a: It is tailor-made for the tongue and groove design of K Aqua unions, but can also be used for other unions with the same dimensions.

plug.seo_p1: The plug serves for the temporary or permanent closing of open threaded connections in sanitary installations.
plug.seo_p2: Injection-molded from stable PP-R and often provided with an integrated sealing ring, the plug withstands the full test pressure during system acceptance.
plug.seo_p3: It protects the piping system from dirt during the construction phase and reliably seals wall plates until the final assembly of the outlet fittings.

faq.q: Does the plug withstand the water pressure during the construction phase?
faq.a: Yes, it is designed to withstand the full test pressure (often more than 15 bar) during the pressure test of the pipe network.

faq.q: Does the plug have to be additionally sealed with Teflon?
faq.a: Our plugs usually have an integrated O-ring, so no additional sealing tape such as Teflon or hemp is required.

faq.q: Can the plug remain permanently in the wall?
faq.a: It is primarily designed as a construction plug. For permanent blind closures, we recommend corresponding brass blind plugs.

pipe-cutter-2040.seo_p1: The pipe cutter d20-d40 (Pipe Cutter 20-40) is the indispensable precision tool for clean cross-cuts on small to medium pipe dimensions.
pipe-cutter-2040.seo_p2: Equipped with a titanium-coated blade and mechanical leverage, the shears guarantee an absolutely right-angled cut through PP-R pipes without material deformation.
pipe-cutter-2040.seo_p3: A clean, burr-free cut is the basic prerequisite for a standardized and durable welded connection. This tool is the constant companion of every installer.

faq.q: Why is a special pipe cutter so important?
faq.a: A right-angled and burr-free cut without crushing is absolutely imperative to ensure a perfect, void-free welded connection.

faq.q: Can the blade be replaced?
faq.a: Yes, in the event of wear or damage, the high-strength steel blade can easily be replaced with an original spare part.

faq.q: Do the shears also work in cold temperatures?
faq.a: The power transmission always works, however the PP-R pipe should not be cut at freezing temperatures, as it could splinter.

pipe-cutter-50125.seo_p1: The large pipe cutter d50-d125 (Pipe Cutter 50-125) is a robust roller cutting tool for large-volume plastic pipes.
pipe-cutter-50125.seo_p2: Its solid steel body and specially hardened cutting wheel effortlessly penetrate thick pipe walls of the large SDR classes with absolute plane parallelism.
pipe-cutter-50125.seo_p3: Ideal for the preparation of main distribution lines in industrial construction, this cutter prevents stress-induced cracks that could occur with simple saw cuts.

faq.q: How does cutting such thick pipes work?
faq.a: The tool is clamped around the pipe, the cutting wheel is slowly advanced and the cutter is guided around the pipe in even turning movements.

faq.q: Does this tool also cut fiber composite pipes?
faq.a: Yes, the specially hardened cutting wheel also cuts through our glass fiber reinforced PPRCT pipes effortlessly and extremely precisely.

faq.q: Does the roller cutter replace chamfering?
faq.a: Socket welding requires no chamfering. The absolutely straight cut of this tool is the perfect preparation for the welding process.

pipe-cutter-50125-1.seo_p1: The high-performance pipe cutter d50-d125 V1 (Pipe Cutter 50-125-1) is a modified version for particularly fast and ergonomic cuts.
pipe-cutter-50125-1.seo_p2: With an optimized spindle guide and an integrated quick-return mechanism, it enormously accelerates the cutting process of massive PP-R pipes.
pipe-cutter-50125-1.seo_p3: Designed for construction projects with high pipe consumption from 50 mm diameter, this tool reduces the physical strain on the user to a minimum.

faq.q: What does 'quick-return mechanism' mean?
faq.a: After completion of the cut, the cutting wheel can be immediately returned to the starting position at the push of a button, without tedious cranking back.

faq.q: Is this model better suited for stationary use?
faq.a: It is mobile, but thanks to its massive design and precise spindle guide, it can be excellently used for stationary prefabrication.

faq.q: Are there spare parts for this pipe cutter?
faq.a: Yes, both the cutting wheel and the guide rollers are permanently available as original spare parts.

hand-welding-machine-2032-complete-set.seo_p1: The hand welding machine d20-d32 in a complete set (Hand Welding Machine 20-32 Complete Set) is the professional base station for small dimensions.
hand-welding-machine-2032-complete-set.seo_p2: It includes a thermostatically controlled 800-watt heating element, Teflon-coated welding tools and a stable stand in a robust metal case.
hand-welding-machine-2032-complete-set.seo_p3: Designed for fast and standardized pre-wall and floor installation, the device keeps the required welding temperature of 260°C absolutely constant at all times.

faq.q: Why is an electronic thermostat so important?
faq.a: Only a precise thermostat guarantees the DVS-compliant permanent temperature of exactly 260°C, which is absolutely necessary for a safe PP-R fusion.

faq.q: How long does the heating phase take?
faq.a: Thanks to the powerful 800-watt heating element, the device usually reaches the operating temperature in under 10 minutes.

faq.q: Which tools are included in the case?
faq.a: The set includes the heating device, the stand, Teflon mandrels for 20, 25 and 32 mm, Allen key and mounting screws in a steel case.

hand-welding-machine-2063-complete-set.seo_p1: The hand welding machine d20-d63 in a complete set (Hand Welding Machine 20-63 Complete Set) covers the entire range of classic building services.
hand-welding-machine-2063-complete-set.seo_p2: With a higher heating output and double slots for heating mandrels, this device enables the simultaneous preparation of different dimensions without changing tools.
hand-welding-machine-2063-complete-set.seo_p3: The robust complete set is designed for the rough everyday life on the construction site and delivers an uncompromisingly precise welding temperature even in adverse weather conditions.

faq.q: Can several welding tools be mounted at the same time?
faq.a: Yes, the wide heating sword head allows the simultaneous mounting of up to three heating mandrel pairs for uninterrupted work.

faq.q: Does the device give a signal when the temperature is reached?
faq.a: A clearly visible indicator light signals to the user as soon as the operating temperature of 260°C has been reached and stabilized.

faq.q: Is the device suitable for continuous operation on large construction sites?
faq.a: Absolutely. The durable heating element and heat-resistant wiring are specially designed for industrial shift operation.

hand-welding-machine-mirror-50125.seo_p1: The hand welding machine with mirror d50-d125 (Hand Welding Machine Mirror 50-125) has been specially developed for large socket welds.
hand-welding-machine-mirror-50125.seo_p2: An extremely flat, large-area heating mirror guarantees the even heating of solid fittings and pipes. The output of over 1200 watts ensures fast heating phases.
hand-welding-machine-mirror-50125.seo_p3: Absolutely essential for the manual processing of large supply lines in industry, where temperature drops during the welding process would be catastrophic.

faq.q: Why is a flat mirror required for large pipes?
faq.a: Large diameters (from 50 mm) have an enormous mass. The flat mirror provides an extremely large contact area to bring the heat quickly and evenly into the plastic.

faq.q: How heavy is the device?
faq.a: Despite its high performance, the device is ergonomically balanced, but for pipes from 90 mm it usually requires two installers for exact joining.

faq.q: Do the Teflon-coated surfaces have to be cleaned?
faq.a: Yes, they should be carefully cleaned after each use while still warm with a lint-free paper towel or a special wooden spatula.

welding-tool.seo_p1: The welding tools (Welding Tool) are the Teflon-coated heating mandrels and heating sockets that take over the actual melting of the PP-R material.
welding-tool.seo_p2: Made of highly thermally conductive alloys and provided with a special non-stick PTFE coating, they guarantee a perfect, residue-free molecular melt.
welding-tool.seo_p3: Only with undamaged and high-quality welding tools can the homogeneity of the connection required by the DVS for a 50-year service life be achieved.

faq.q: When must a welding tool be replaced?
faq.a: As soon as the Teflon coating is scratched or PP-R residues burn firmly, the tool must be replaced in order to avoid faulty weld seams.

faq.q: Why am I not allowed to scrape off plastic residues with a knife?
faq.a: A knife immediately destroys the micro-fine PTFE non-stick coating. Use only soft cloths on the still hot tool.

faq.q: Does the K Aqua welding tool also fit on third-party devices?
faq.a: The mounting hole corresponds to the industrial standard, so that our tools fit on almost all professional socket welding machines.

welding-machine-50125-complete-set.seo_p1: The table welding machine d50-d125 (Welding Machine 50-125 Complete Set) offers stationary precision for the prefabrication of large pipe assemblies.
welding-machine-50125-complete-set.seo_p2: It has clamping jaws, a lever mechanism for energy-saving joining and a digitally controlled heating element for absolutely exact joining pressures and times.
welding-machine-50125-complete-set.seo_p3: In the workshop production of manifolds or complex industrial assemblies, this machine eliminates human errors and maximizes processing speed.

faq.q: What is the advantage of the stationary machine compared to the hand tool?
faq.a: The lever mechanism allows an exactly linear, tilt-free insertion of the large pipes, which would be extremely strenuous by hand.

faq.q: Can small pipes also be welded with it?
faq.a: Technically yes, however the machine is specially designed for the high joining forces of the dimensions 50 mm to 125 mm.

faq.q: How is the pipe fixed?
faq.a: Universal clamping jaws with various inserts grip the pipe gently but absolutely firmly in order to guarantee a powerful, axial movement.

butt-welding-machine-90250.seo_p1: The butt welding machine d90-d250 (Butt Welding Machine 90-250) is the high-end system for flangeless pipe-to-pipe connections in large format.
butt-welding-machine-90250.seo_p2: A hydraulic press unit, a CNC-controlled heating mirror and a precise pipe planer ensure a fully automated, loggable weld seam at the highest level.
butt-welding-machine-90250.seo_p3: For municipal main water pipes or industrial cooling water networks from 90 mm, this device is indispensable for carrying out certified and approvable butt welds.

faq.q: What is the difference between socket and butt welding?
faq.a: With butt welding, the pipe ends are milled flat and melted together directly without an additional fitting (socket).

faq.q: Are the welding data saved for quality control?
faq.a: Yes, the integrated CNC control logs temperature, pressure and time for each individual weld seam for later evaluation.

faq.q: Why is a planer integrated?
faq.a: The planer mills both pipe ends absolutely parallel and oxidation-free before welding, which is strictly necessary for a permanent molecular connection.

electrofusion-machine.seo_p1: The electrofusion machine controls the fully automatic welding process of electrofusion sockets by electrical resistance heating.
electrofusion-machine.seo_p2: The intelligent microprocessor reads the barcode of the fitting via scanner and automatically calculates the exact voltage and welding time depending on the ambient temperature.
electrofusion-machine.seo_p3: Essential for repairs in extremely narrow shafts, subsequent connections or underground installations where classic socket welding is impossible due to space constraints.

faq.q: How does the machine read the welding parameters?
faq.a: Every electrofusion socket has a barcode, which the user reads with the connected scanner; the machine adjusts itself fully automatically.

faq.q: Does the machine compensate for temperature fluctuations on the construction site?
faq.a: Yes, an ambient sensor measures the temperature and automatically adjusts the welding time (longer in winter, shorter in summer).

faq.q: Does the pipe have to be peeled before electrofusion?
faq.a: Absolutely! The oxide layer on the PP-R pipe must be mechanically removed in the welding area with a special peeling device.

welding-tool-for-weld-in-saddles.seo_p1: The saddle welding tool (Welding Tool for Weld-in Saddles) is specially designed for mounting weld-in saddles on existing PP-R pipes.
welding-tool-for-weld-in-saddles.seo_p2: It consists of a concavely shaped heating mandrel for the pipe wall and a convex heating socket for the saddle, both with high-quality Teflon coating.
welding-tool-for-weld-in-saddles.seo_p3: It heats exactly the required area on the base pipe in order to fuse the saddle homogeneously and inseparably with the piping system.

faq.q: Why does the tool have a concave and a convex side?
faq.a: The concave (arched) side heats the round outer pipe, while the convex side brings exactly the saddle-shaped branch to melting temperature.

faq.q: Does one tool fit all pipes?
faq.a: No, you need an exactly fitting saddle welding tool for each main pipe/branch combination (e.g. 63 mm to 20 mm).

faq.q: How is the tool mounted on the welding machine?
faq.a: It is screwed directly onto the heating sword of the K Aqua hand welding machine like a normal heating mandrel with an Allen screw.

drilling-tool-for-weld-in-saddle.seo_p1: The special drill for weld-in saddles (Drilling Tool for Weld-in Saddle) is the precise preparation tool for saddle branches.
drilling-tool-for-weld-in-saddle.seo_p2: It not only drills the exactly required hole in the water-bearing main pipe, but also neatly mills out the edge area for the subsequent welding.
drilling-tool-for-weld-in-saddle.seo_p3: An extremely sharp and clean drill hole is critical so that no plastic chips get into the pipe network during the later welding of the saddle.

faq.q: Why can't I use a normal wood or metal drill?
faq.a: Standard drills tear the plastic and produce uncontrolled chips. Our special drill mills the hole and cleanly catches the chip.

faq.q: Does the drill fit in a standard cordless screwdriver?
faq.a: Yes, the drill has a standardized hexagonal shaft that fits into any standard drill chuck.

faq.q: Does the hole have to be deburred?
faq.a: No, the milling head of the drill is designed in such a way that it automatically prepares and smooths the hole edge for the subsequent welding.

welding-tool-for-repairing-plug.seo_p1: The repair welding tool (Welding Tool for Repairing Plug) is a highly specialized attachment for repairing drilled pipes.
welding-tool-for-repairing-plug.seo_p2: This conical heating pin specifically heats the interior of a damaged drill hole and simultaneously the corresponding PP-R repair plug to melting temperature.
welding-tool-for-repairing-plug.seo_p3: It is the savior on every construction site to quickly and demonstrably tightly close accidentally drilled pipes (e.g. during wall mounting).

faq.q: How exactly does the repair pin work?
faq.a: The conical tool melts the drill hole. Afterwards, the also heated PP-R repair plug is pressed into the hole and fuses permanently.

faq.q: Is the repaired spot really safe?
faq.a: Yes, it is not a mere bonding, but a molecular weld that withstands the same pressure as the undamaged pipe.

faq.q: Which drill diameters can be repaired?
faq.a: The tool is ideal for typical drilling accidents (dowel holes) in the range of 7 mm to 11 mm.

repairing-plug.seo_p1: The repair plug (Repairing Plug) is a solid PP-R pin which, in combination with the special welding tool, repairs drill hole emergencies.
repairing-plug.seo_p2: It is made of the identical material as the K Aqua pipe system and fuses to an absolutely homogeneous mass when inserted into the damaged pipe.
repairing-plug.seo_p3: Instead of opening up walls over a large area to replace pipe sections, the hole is simply welded; the repaired spot is then just as pressure-resistant as the original pipe.

faq.q: What material is the repair plug made of?
faq.a: It consists of 100% high-quality Polypropylene Random Copolymer (PP-R) Type 3, exactly like our K Aqua pipe systems.

faq.q: Must the plug be cut off after welding?
faq.a: Yes, after the welding spot has cooled down completely, the protruding end of the plug is cut off flush with the pipe wall.

faq.q: Can I use the plug when the pipe network is filled?
faq.a: No, the water must be completely turned off on the affected line and the pipe must be dry in the area of the drill hole.
